etymologies.etymologyHTML: From basket +‎ ball.

definitions.definition: (sports, uncountable) A sport in which two opposing teams of five players strive to put a ball through a hoop.
(countable) The particular kind of ball used in the sport of basketball.

quote.text: by high school he was basketballing with the best of an all-Negro league

definitions.definition: (informal, transitive) To throw in a similar way to when shooting a basketball.

quote.text: He took a sip from a paper coffee-cup , crumpled it up and basketballed it into a small rubbish bin about five feet from him.
